notes: SHIFT (either) is modifier 1 for the whole controller; the controller also sends other notes for most shifted buttons. Pad modes are modifiers 4 / 5 (0 Hot Cue, 1 Auto Loop, 2 Fader Cuts, 3 Sampler 1-8, 4 Beat Jump, 5 Sampler 9-16); Sampler 1-8 are deck C's cells, 9-16 deck D's. Jogs: 1024 counts per turn; SHIFT + jog searches (JOG SEARCH, not Mixxx's move by a share of the track). SCRATCH toggles turntable / jog mode (it starts as turntable). FX: both FX knobs drive units 1 and 2 (as in Mixxx); the encoder steps knob 1 (SHIFT: knob 2) of each; FX ◀ ▶ pick the effect (SHIFT: key semitone up / down). Tempo fader inverted (Mixxx's invert); its direction is not confirmed. FX switch (up or down) sets effect 1 of its unit on, middle off; the effect has to be a group slot (Group mode). Not mapped: SHIFT + CUE (start and stop), loop rolls (SHIFT + Auto Loop pads, LOOP while a loop plays), SHIFT + LOOP while in a loop (reloop and stop), browse push (library focus / go to item), SHIFT + browse (waveform zoom), beatgrid, VU meters, mode LED blinking. Translated from the Mixxx mapping by h67ma, bad1dea5 and photoenix, GPL-2.0-or-later (crates/control/profiles/MIXXX-NOTICE.md).
